name: Kimai
summary: Kimai is open-source time tracking that a business can host for free, or rent as Kimai Cloud at €2.99 or €3.99 per user a month on annual billing, excluding tax. Both cloud plans include invoicing, Cloud Professional adds monthly timesheet approval, and the cloud is hosted in Germany.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: Kimai's code is open source under the AGPL-3.0 licence, and the self-hosted version is free.
Kimai Cloud is hosted with Hetzner in Falkenstein, Germany.
On self-hosted Kimai, a free third-party plugin adds a weekly approval step in which a team lead or admin approves or denies each week.
Kimai's post-mortem says Kimai Cloud users were served an expired SSL certificate on May 11, 2026.
Kimai says it has raised its cloud price once since 2019 and kept existing customers on their old price.

plans.name: Self-hosted
plans.notes: Open source; you run the server, and first-party plugins are priced separately

plans.name: Cloud Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually, excluding tax; €3.99 on monthly billing. No USD price is published

plans.name: Cloud Professional
plans.notes: Billed annually, excluding tax; €4.99 on monthly billing. Adds monthly timesheet approval; single sign-on and kiosk need annual billing

hiddenCosts: Cloud prices are in euros and exclude tax. Kimai publishes no USD price.
On self-hosted Kimai, the first-party Working hours plugin for monthly approval costs €299 a year excluding VAT.
Single sign-on and kiosk mode on Kimai Cloud need Professional on annual billing.

contract.cancellation: Cancel up to one day before the end of the subscription period. Fees paid in advance are not refunded, and the cloud service is sold to business customers only.
contract.dataExport: Timesheets as PDF, XLSX, CSV or HTML, plus a JSON API on both cloud plans.
